meta.title: Mty Agentic Labs — Agentic transformation for companies
meta.description: We train your team, build your company brain and deploy AI agents connected to your systems, with governance and a human accountable for every workflow. From Monterrey.

hero.kicker: From chatbots that answer questions to agents that do real work.
hero.sub: We train your team, build your organization's company brain and deploy agents connected to your systems. With governance, and always with a human accountable for every workflow.

console.aria: Your systems, one brain, agent teams

shift.label: THE SHIFT
shift.title: Companies no longer buy software that helps. They buy finished work.
shift.lead: An agent doesn't explain how to reconcile an account: it reconciles it, leaves evidence and asks for your approval only on the exception.

items.title: Leverage, not cuts
items.body: The question isn't who to replace, but how your company grows at the same cost. AI isn't coming for your job; it's coming for the busywork.

items.title: Your data is the asset
items.body: Models are interchangeable. Your data, your integrations and the way you operate are what's valuable, and they stay with you.

items.title: A business decision
items.body: It's not an IT project: it's a cost-structure decision. It's measured against a baseline, and what works gets scaled.

items.title: What each person learns stays in their chat
items.body: We set up a company brain: shared memory, context and method, so knowledge rises to leadership and comes back down as processes.

items.title: My systems don't talk and we re-key everything
items.body: We connect your ERP, email, Drive and spreadsheets with automated workflows and MCP connectors. Information flows without re-keying.

items.title: We lose hours copying, reconciling and reporting
items.body: We deploy agents that run the task end to end, check conditions and escalate only the exceptions to a person.

items.title: We tried AI and it never reached production
items.body: We start with what's verifiable: one process, one metric and a pilot against the baseline. What works scales; what doesn't gets switched off.

route.label: THE ROADMAP
route.title: Four steps to an agentic operation.
route.lead: First, a personal agent for every employee. Then teams of agents coordinated by people. Finally, an operation run by humans and advised by agents.
route.caption: MTY AGENTIC LABS

steps.title: Assessment
steps.body: Start with what's verifiable. Each person maps their weekly tasks and the one they'd delegate today; we review processes and systems.

steps.title: Training
steps.body: Your team learns to work with Claude on real cases from their own operation, in live sessions, in person or online.
points: Prompts, skills and connectors to email, calendar and Drive

steps.title: Company brain
steps.body: So what your team learns with AI doesn't stay in their chat. Knowledge rises through the weekly log and comes back down as skills.

steps.title: Agents in operation
steps.body: Agents connected to your systems doing real work, with defined autonomy levels and a human accountable for every workflow.
points: Monitoring and evidence for every action

services.label: SERVICES
services.title: We train your team. We build what's missing.

items.title: AI for Business workshop
items.body: Your team works with Claude on their real operation: fundamentals and responsible use, prompting, Excel and reports, skills and connectors.
items.meta: 2 sessions × 3 h or 4 sessions × 2 h · groups of 1 to 15

items.title: Monthly coaching
items.body: After the workshop we bring what was learned into each team's real processes: workflows, templates and automations.
items.meta: 4 one-hour sessions a month, per team

items.title: Company brain
items.body: We design and roll out your organization's memory, context and skills, with roles, rules and a cadence that turns it into a habit.

items.title: Process automation
items.body: Repetitive work that runs itself: workflows that connect your systems and operate 24/7.

items.title: AI agents
items.body: Virtual employees that run end to end and escalate exceptions to a person.

items.title: Integration and custom software
items.body: The missing pieces: connectors, MCP servers and internal apps on top of your data.

items.title: Data and forecasting
items.body: From raw data to decisions: forecasting models, dashboards and intelligent search.

models.title: Turnkey
models.body: Closed scope and a defined deliverable from the assessment onward. Delivered with documentation, training and a stabilization period.

models.title: Monthly maintenance
models.body: Continuous improvements, monitoring and priority support for what already runs in production.

services.note: Training is priced per group, not per person. Projects are quoted after the assessment.

governance.label: GOVERNANCE
governance.title: The agent proposes. A person decides.
governance.lead: The challenge is no longer whether agents can do it; it's which architecture and governance keep your information and your money safe. For each process we define how much autonomy each agent gets.

levels.name: Assistant
levels.body: The agent answers and drafts when asked. It doesn't touch any system.
levels.human: The person does all the work and uses the agent for support.

levels.name: Proposes
levels.body: The agent prepares the complete work (a reconciliation, a report, a reply) and leaves it ready for review.

levels.name: Executes with approval
levels.body: The agent executes in your systems, but every action waits for an approval click.

levels.name: Escalates exceptions
levels.body: The agent resolves the normal cases and leaves evidence; only what breaks the rule reaches a person.

levels.name: Governed zero touch
levels.body: The process runs on its own within limits, controls and an audit log.
levels.human: The person owns the process and its limits.

principles.title: A human accountable
principles.body: Every workflow has an owner. Publishing, sending or paying never happens without their sign-off.

principles.title: Money has its own lane
principles.body: The agent never holds the bank keys: payments go through a circuit with controls and double review.

principles.title: Data traffic light
principles.body: Clear rules on which information each tool may use, with zero-retention enterprise plans.

principles.title: Our own hardware
principles.body: A rack with 4 GPUs and 30 GB VRAM in Monterrey. Local inference for the models that allow it.

agentos.label: WHERE WE'RE GOING
agentos.title: AgentOS: an office of agent teams.
agentos.lead: Claude, trained, connected to your company and executing tasks. You hire a team, the agents work in Claude, and you supervise and approve from the office.

teams.name: Assistant
teams.body: The front door: knows what's there, what's missing and what's waiting for your approval.

teams.name: Marketing
teams.body: Research, calendar, creatives and results reporting.

teams.name: Sales
teams.body: Prospecting, lead scoring, proposals and follow-up.

teams.name: Collections
teams.body: Receivables aging, payment reconciliation and reminders.

teams.name: Finance
teams.body: Monthly close, financial statements and tax calendar.

teams.name: Leadership
teams.body: Priorities, decision memos and quarterly plan.

teams.name: Web development
teams.body: Design, build and QA of sites and stores.

board.label: BOARD
board.rule: Only a person can move a task to Approved.

principles: An agent proposes; only a person approves.
Everything external (publish, send, pay) is a draft you execute.
Local first: it runs on your company's computer.

work.label: WORK
work.title: Real work, across industries.

items.body: Custom operations platform (CRM, quotes, projects and purchasing) with an MCP server so Claude operates on their data with the same permissions as each user.
Demand forecasting application with several statistical models, automatic selection of the best one and 100% local processing.
Store, admin panel and a Telegram agent that queries the live catalog and orders with a salesperson's permissions.
AI for Business program by team and a company brain so what's learned reaches leadership.

Training path in agentic marketing on Meta Ads and building their own site with agents.

stack.label: ECOSYSTEM
stack.lead: We build on Claude, MCP and the best open source projects. Models are interchangeable; the architecture is yours.

items.a: The starting point is leverage: the same team does more and leaves the busywork to agents. There is always a human accountable for the agents' work.

items.q: What happens to my company's information?
items.a: We define a traffic light of which data each tool may use, work with zero-retention enterprise plans and, when the model allows it, with local inference on our own hardware.
Not on its own. The agent proposes; money moves through a circuit with controls, approvals and an audit log.
No. If your team handles Excel, presentations and email, they can start. Training is 70% hands-on, on their own cases.

items.q: Does this lock us into a vendor or a model?
items.a: No. We design with a vendor-agnostic architecture: models are interchangeable, and your data, integrations and skills stay with you.
With an assessment: we identify one or two verifiable processes, measure their baseline and define the first closed-scope step.
